name: Construction expertise review
about: Reviewing a construction-technical expert report or a warranty case: every conclusion must follow the chain FACT -> EVIDENCE -> NORM -> CONCLUSION.

criteria.question: Does every conclusion follow the full chain FACT -> EVIDENCE -> NORM -> CONCLUSION, with no link skipped?

anchors.10: every conclusion has all four links
anchors.4: a conclusion with a missing link

criteria.question: Are the cited norms (SP, GOST, SNiP, methodology) the right ones, the right edition, and applied to the right object and date?

anchors.4: a wrong or outdated norm relied on

criteria.question: Is the cause of each defect established (design, construction, operation) rather than assumed, and tied to the responsible party?
Does it state contradictions and weaknesses honestly, including those that hurt the side asking?
Can a manager act on it: statuses of conclusions, what to do next, in plain words?

priority.name: Check every link
priority.how: Walk each conclusion back through FACT -> EVIDENCE -> NORM and mark the status of every link before writing anything else.

priority.name: Measurement first
priority.how: Check how each measurement was taken (instrument, verification, method, conditions) before trusting any number in the report.
